text:
Sophie K: quick sync — can we get a short status on kernel patch, continuous-batching canary, and KV warmup? trying to assemble a single milestone for next week

Chen L: kernel patch #4287 is green in CI, waiting on one perf bench run. target merge Tue EOD unless the bench regresses. will ping when merged :white_check_mark:

Maria G: continuous-batching canary started yesterday. 3% traffic to canary, latency p90 looks fine so far (no tail spikes in the first 6h). sending dashboard link: https://graf.redwood/ops/canary/CB-2026-03

Jamal (runtime): KV warmup: prototyping prefetch policy is done. need eng-infra to bump disk cache from 10GB -> 50GB on canary machines (ticket INF-1091). blocked until infra ops approves the quota change

Alex P: ran the end-to-end perf job vs latest kernel branch — saw a small regression in throughput under 1k seq workloads. attaching snippet: ```
=== perf summary ===
baseline: 12.4k tokens/s
kernel-branch: 11.7k tokens/s (-5.6%)
hotpath: increased mutex contention in kv_get path (samples attached)
```

Chen L: ack. I saw a couple of mutex hotspots in the flamegraph — pushing a lightweight fix that reduces lock hold time. will open PR and include perf numbers in description. PR will depend on infra quota change only if we want larger cache on canary

Maria G: for the canary we can keep at 10GB for now, but results may understate warmup benefits. if infra approves, we should repeat with 50GB and compare. I can run both and tag the results.

Sophie K: who owns the integration test gating for the kernel->batching->kv combo? we need a single person to /merge once green and doc the rollback plan

Jamal (runtime): I can own the gating for this cycle. will coordinate with QA to run the combined smoke suite and perf quickcheck. expected runway: 4 hours after Chen's PR merges. I will post a run summary in this thread and set a canary cutoff time

Chen L: PR link: https://git.redwood/repo/4289 — small lock scope change + added a unit test. reviewers: @Maria G, @Alex P

Alex P: will review today, focusing on the lock scope change and kv path microbench. if I spot regressions I'll file a follow-up and block the gate. planning review by 14:00 PT

deploy-bot: deploy scheduled: canary-group-3 -> runtime-canary @ 2026-03-19T02:00:00Z (automated) :robot_face:

Sophie K: ok action items: Chen merge PR (#4289) -> Jamal runs integration + perf -> Maria re-runs canary with 50GB if infra approves -> Alex final review -> Sophie to publish milestone update. pls add any timeline slips here

Maria G: FYI INF-1091 assigned to infra-ops (Jira INF-1091). pinged for quota change, ETA 24-48h

Alex P: noted. will escalate if perf review finds larger regression

Jamal (runtime): posting run logs here once I start — should be ~2h after merge

Sophie K: thanks everyone. if anything looks risky, call the rollback (canary -> previous image) and notify SRE. :thumbsup:
